format: New Carl's Jr. Restaurant in a 3,200 square foot freestanding building with drive-thru (Traditional Format, current prototype), excluding land/real property

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin the operation of a newly-developed Carl's Jr. Restaurant ranges from approximately $1,816,500 - $3,304,700 for a 3,200 square foot freestanding building and $1,488,000 - $2,862,135 for a 2,200 square foot freestanding building. This includes $55,000 to $99,000, which must be paid to us.

fee.quote: The Initial Franchise Fee is $25,000, although the balance of the Initial Franchise Fee due to CJR is reduced to $15,000 for a Restaurant developed pursuant to the terms of a Development Agreement.
fee.note: Under a Development Agreement, a $10,000 non-refundable Development Fee per restaurant is paid upfront and credited against the $25,000 fee (balance $15,000). Opening Training Support Fee (All-Star Team) for the first 2 restaurants estimated $30,000 to $70,000 in Item 5 ($30,000 to $74,000 in Item 7). Additional FMTP trainees $500 per person per week; 10-Day Operations Overview up to $500 per person. CJR may waive initial fees as incentives; in 2026 it waived the fee for some takeovers of closed restaurants.

royalty.quote: Royalty 4% of Gross Sales (2) Within 10 calendar days after the end of each fiscal week

adFund.quote: An advertising and promotion obligation ("APO") in an amount set forth in your Franchise Agreement. The APO will be up to 7% of Gross Sales. Currently, the APO is 6% of Gross Sales (3)
adFund.note: Currently 6%, up to 7% (increase of no more than 1/2% of Gross Sales in any 12-month period); split between a Production Fund and a Media Fund. Under the CJR 2026 Development Incentive Program, royalty and APO are each reduced by 3% in year 1, 2% in year 2 and 1% in year 3 for restaurants opening on or ahead of schedule.

otherRecurring.name: Digital Tech Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $160 per fiscal period (4 week accounting period); effective August 11, 2026: 3% of Gross Sales generated through First Party Digital Channels, monthly minimum $160 / maximum $600 (Year 1), $700 (Year 2), $800 (Year 3)

otherRecurring.name: Software Support Fee (Genius or PAR Brink) and CrunchTime
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $118 per Franchised Restaurant per fiscal period (4 week accounting period); in addition, $825 per Franchised Restaurant bi-annually (every 26 week accounting period) for back office support fee payable to CrunchTime

otherRecurring.name: Star University Access Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $18.20 per Fiscal Period (currently a 4-week accounting period)

otherRecurring.name: Lease / Sublease Administration Fee (only if leasing/subleasing from CJR or affiliate, on renewal/amendment)

Excludes 78 non-freestanding (travel plaza, gas/convenience, college, airport), 15 with incomplete data and 71 Dual Concept restaurants, and restaurants outside the US. 728 franchised + 50 company-operated restaurants in Section I.

special: CJR (through the 2013 assignment from CKE) holds real estate leases and subleases with some franchisees; those franchisees may pay a Lease / Sublease Administration Fee (currently $2,500 per year) and reimburse lease costs, but no rent-as-%-of-sales to the franchisor is disclosed in Items 5-7. Opening Training Support Fee $30,000 to $74,000 is paid to CJR. Development Incentive Program reduces royalty and APO by 3%/2%/1% in years 1-3.
issues: Item 7 Traditional Format line items do not add up to the printed totals (low lines sum to $1,871,000 and high to $3,403,700 vs printed $1,816,500 and $3,304,700; build-out low lines sum to $1,626,000 vs printed $1,626,500); printed cover/Item 7 totals used. Opening Training Support Fee is $30,000-$70,000 in Item 5 but $30,000-$74,000 in Item 7. Item 20 fiscal year 2026 ends January 2026. Item 19 labels incentive labor costs but defines 'Indirect Labor Costs'.
